body_markdown:
Convenient Public Storage options in Dallas include 2425 Canton St near Deep Ellum, 903 Slocum St in the Design District, 2320 N Central Expy near Uptown and 4740 Harry Hines Blvd in the Medical District. These locations connect with major routes such as I-30, I-35E and U.S. 75.


The most convenient choice depends on the part of Dallas you travel through most often. Compare each location’s access hours, unit sizes and features before reserving.


## What Public Storage Options Are Available in Dallas?


Public Storage has 185 facilities in Dallas and nearby communities. Climate-controlled storage is available at 139 facilities, while 148 offer car storage. Available spaces range from lockers to 10×30 units.


Common unit sizes are widely available throughout the area:


Unit size Dallas-area facilities offering the size


5×5 138

Monthly prices start at $10, and the average monthly unit price is $80. Prices, promotions, features and availability vary by location and can change.


## Convenient Self-Storage in Dallas: 2425 Canton St


Public Storage at[2425 Canton St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/5982.html) is east of downtown near Deep Ellum, with access from I-30 and central Dallas streets.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Canton Street location provides an in-city option for customers who live or work downtown, in Deep Ellum or in nearby East Dallas neighborhoods. Its current 10 p.m. closing time also offers more evening flexibility than some Dallas facilities.


## Where Else Can You Find Convenient Self-Storage in Dallas?


Dallas covers a large area, so a facility along a familiar highway or neighborhood corridor can reduce cross-town travel.


### Design District Near I-35E


Public Storage at[903 Slocum St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/5980.html) is in the Design District near I-35E and the Trinity River corridor.


The facility offers climate-controlled storage, car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may suit customers in the Design District, Victory Park and nearby downtown areas or those who regularly use I-35E.


### North Central Expressway Near Uptown


Public Storage at[2320 N Central Expy](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/2352.html) is along U.S. 75 near Uptown, Cityplace and Old East Dallas.


The facility offers climate-controlled storage; car, boat and RV storage; and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** The North Central Expressway location can work well for customers whose routine includes Uptown, Knox-Henderson or central Dallas travel along U.S. 75.


### Harry Hines Boulevard Near the Medical District


Public Storage at[4740 Harry Hines Blvd](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/2599.html) is in the Medical District near Inwood Road, Dallas Love Field and I-35E.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may fit customers in the Medical District, Oak Lawn and nearby northwest Dallas areas or those who regularly travel along Harry Hines Boulevard and I-35E.


## What Makes a Self-Storage Facility Convenient in Dallas?


In Dallas, choosing a facility near the right highway or side of downtown can make repeat visits easier.


When comparing Dallas storage facilities, consider:


- **Your regular route:** Look near I-35E, U.S. 75, I-30 or another road you already use.
- **Neighborhood:** A facility near downtown, the Design District, Uptown or the Medical District can help reduce unnecessary cross-town travel.
- **Access hours:** The featured Canton Street and Slocum Street locations currently provide standard access until 10 p.m., while the other two close at 9 p.m.
- [Climate-controlled storage in Dallas](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/climate-controlled-storage-units) **:** Dallas’s warm, humid periods and seasonal weather changes can affect belongings that react to changing conditions. These units are designed to help maintain more consistent temperature and humidity levels than non-climate-controlled storage.
- **Indoor or outdoor access:** Indoor units may involve hallway or elevator access. Some outdoor units offer Drive-Up Access, but confirm the feature for the exact unit.
- [Vehicle storage in Dallas](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas/car-storage-units) **:** Car, boat, RV and motorcycle storage is available at select Dallas-area facilities.
- **Unit size:** Choose enough space for your belongings and a walkway if you expect to retrieve items regularly.


## Which Storage Unit Size Should You Choose?


Choose a size based on what you plan to store and how you want to arrange the unit.


- A **5×5 unit** can hold boxes, seasonal decorations and smaller household items.
- A **5×10 unit** can accommodate the contents of one room, including some furniture.
- A **10×10 unit** offers space for furnishings and boxes from several rooms.
- A **10×20 unit** can support a larger move or home project involving multiple rooms.


Actual dimensions and capacities vary. Use the[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) and review the specific unit before renting when possible.


## How Do You Choose the Most Convenient Storage Facility in Dallas?


Start with the highway and neighborhood already in your routine. Canton Street may suit downtown and Deep Ellum, while Slocum Street provides a Design District option near I-35E. North Central Expressway may be easier for Uptown and U.S. 75 travel, and Harry Hines Boulevard can fit a Medical District or Love Field routine.


Then compare access hours, unit type, size and features. If you need climate-controlled storage, Drive-Up Access, vehicle storage or 24/7 Access, confirm availability for the exact facility and unit before reserving.

Featured central options include 2425 Canton St near Deep Ellum and 903 Slocum St in the Design District.

Yes. Car storage is available at 148 area facilities, including the featured Slocum Street and North Central Expressway locations. Space type, dimensions and availability vary.


### Does Public Storage offer 24/7 Access in Dallas?


Select Dallas-area locations offer 24/7 Access. Availability and requirements vary, so confirm the feature for the specific facility before renting.


### Which featured Dallas locations have the latest standard access hours?


The Canton Street and Slocum Street facilities currently list standard access until 10 p.m. daily. The North Central Expressway and Harry Hines Boulevard locations currently close at 9 p.m.


### How much does a storage unit cost in Dallas?


Monthly prices start at $10, and the average monthly unit price is $80. Your price will depend on the location, size, features, promotion and current availability.


### How can I find a Public Storage facility near me in Dallas?


Search by your address, neighborhood or ZIP code on the[Dallas Public Storage page](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-tx-dallas) . Compare each facility’s route, access hours and available unit features.


## Find Convenient Self-Storage in Dallas


Public Storage offers options near downtown, the Design District, Uptown, the Medical District and throughout the Dallas area. Choose a facility that fits the roads you already use, then confirm the unit size, access hours and features before reserving.
